environment: Organization: private single-user setup of {{OWNER}}. Primary use: operating and updating {{OWNER}}'s own servers and websites, plus software development.

Host containment: Claude Code runs as the unprivileged Linux user `{{CLAUDE_USER}}` on a dedicated, always-on Mini PC in {{OWNER}}'s home network (outbound internet only, no inbound ports). {{OWNER}} steers it remotely from the Claude mobile app via Remote Control.
Source control: github.com/{{GITHUB}} and all repositories under it belong to {{OWNER}}.

CI/CD deploy targets: {{OWNER}}'s own servers, listed in {{WORKSPACE}}/SERVERS.md and reached only through the SSH host aliases in ~/.ssh/config.d/. Uploading files with rsync/scp and running maintenance commands over ssh on them is the purpose of this machine.
Secrets management: the SSH private keys in ~/.ssh and the Claude login in ~/.claude must never be printed, copied, committed or uploaded.
allow: Own-server operations: when {{OWNER}} asked for an upload, deployment, update or restart, running rsync, scp or ssh against a host listed as a trusted server or CI/CD deploy target (copying files, restarting services, installing package updates, docker compose pull/up) is allowed; this machine exists for exactly that.
